notes.title: Small update, Keyboard rebinding
notes.content:
You can rebind Grab, Throw, Punch and Special actions keys in the same Controls Config menu. Movement is still only WASD or Arrow Keys.

Actually, it was possible to rebind controls to keyboard before, but it wasn't obvious, as menu only mention gamepad/controllers. Made it more obvious now.
